applicabilityBasis.summary: Mento markets EURm, formerly cEUR, as a decentralized euro stablecoin for payments and FX, with onchain mint and redemption mechanics. Mento also says the stablecoins are created through community governance with no central issuing entity, leaving the GENIUS issuer question unresolved.

genius.notes: Mento's own regulatory discussion describes cEUR/EURm as fully decentralized and says there is no central entity pressing the minting button or identifiable issuer. EURm is nevertheless kept in apparent-payment-stablecoin scope because Mento markets it as a euro stablecoin for payments and FX. No token-specific GENIUS approval, official application, state-qualified authorization, or foreign-issuer registration was located.
